story.iWant: start the backend API service automatically
story.soThat: the frontend application has reliable data interfaces ready for use
story.tasks:
Task 1: Backend Service Startup Core Functionality (AC: 1, 5) - Subtask 1.1: Implement Python process detection and startup logic - Subtask 1.2: Configure service startup parameters and environment variables - Subtask 1.3: Implement process status monitoring and PID management - Subtask 1.4: Create startup logging mechanism - Subtask 1.5: Implement startup timeout and error handling
Task 2: API Health Check System (AC: 2) - Subtask 2.1: Implement /health endpoint verification logic - Subtask 2.2: Implement /api/docs endpoint accessibility check - Subtask 2.3: Add API response time validation - Subtask 2.4: Create endpoint status reporting mechanism - Subtask 2.5: Implement health check retry mechanism
Task 3: Database Connection Integration (AC: 3) - Subtask 3.1: Implement Redis connection verification - Subtask 3.2: Implement PostgreSQL connection testing - Subtask 3.3: Add database permission verification - Subtask 3.4: Create connection status monitoring - Subtask 3.5: Implement connection error recovery mechanism
Task 4: Application Configuration and State Management (AC: 4) - Subtask 4.1: Load and apply environment configuration - Subtask 4.2: Initialize application internal state - Subtask 4.3: Verify frontend API readiness status - Subtask 4.4: Implement configuration validation and error handling - Subtask 4.5: Create status reporting interface

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Start Python backend service (FastAPI/Flask) and verify process running status 2. Verify API endpoints respond normally (/health, /api/docs) with response time < 2 seconds 3. Load environment configuration and ensure database connections are normal (Redis:6379, PostgreSQL:5432) 4. Initialize application state and prepare to accept frontend requests 5. Record service startup logs for problem diagnosis

artifact.reason: 主要后端服务编排器，需要实现核心启动逻辑
现有健康检查器，支持HTTP端点验证和响应时间监控
数据库服务管理器，为后端服务提供数据库连接支持
FastAPI路由器，定义了后端API的端点结构
服务依赖分析器，用于验证启动顺序
端口管理器，用于Backend:8000端口分配
超时管理器，用于后端服务启动超时控制
配置管理器，用于后端服务配置
进度跟踪器，用于后端启动进度跟踪

constraints.constraint: 服务启动序列：遵循 Database → Backend 顺序，使用 ServiceDependencyAnalyzer 验证依赖关系
健康检查集成：使用现有 HealthChecker 类进行端点验证，支持 /health 和 /api/docs 端点
配置管理：使用 ServiceConfigurator 进行后端特定配置，支持环境特定配置
统一错误格式：遵循 {code, message, solution, details} 格式
异步操作：使用 asyncio 模式进行并发 API 操作
端口管理：使用现有 PortManager 分配 Backend:8000 端口
测试标准：服务启动、API端点验证、数据库集成、性能基准、集成测试、错误处理测试

interface.name: Backend Service Manager
interface.signature: class BackendServiceManager: start(), stop(), health_check(), get_status()

tests.standards: 服务测试：测试后端启动、API端点验证和关闭场景。端点测试：测试/health和/api/docs可访问性和响应格式。数据库集成测试：测试数据库连接和查询操作。性能测试：API端点响应时间基准测试。集成测试：完整后端服务启动流程测试。错误处理测试：各种失败场景和恢复机制测试。
